title: Runway launches real-time Gen-2 video editing workspace
summary: Runway unveiled a real-time editing workspace for Gen-2 that lets creators mix live video with AI-generated sequences inside a collaborative timeline.
recommendedActions: Experiment with the featured tool in a pilot project.
Share a behind-the-scenes breakdown or tutorial for your audience.
excerpt: Runway introduced a new real-time editing workspace for Gen-2 that lets video teams collaborate on AI-assisted sequences. Creators can mix captured footage with generated assets, adjust prompts on the fly, and publish straight to social channels.

title: Notion adds AI workspace analytics for solopreneurs
summary: Notion AI now offers workspace analytics that surface bottlenecks, automation opportunities, and content reuse suggestions tailored to small teams.
recommendedActions: Evaluate partnership or integration opportunities with the tool.
Assess potential to streamline internal operations using this solution.
excerpt: Notion released AI workspace analytics that highlight projects that are slipping, templates that are underused, and automation suggestions based on repetitive updates. Solopreneurs can convert the insights into zap-ready automations.

title: AI education platform Maven partners with Adobe to teach multimodal storytelling
summary: Maven and Adobe launched a cohort-based course that helps creators blend video, audio, and generative assets into a single storytelling pipeline.
recommendedActions: Transform the playbook into a live session or workshop.
Roll the framework into team training or SOP updates.
excerpt: Maven partnered with Adobe to run a 4-week cohort on multimodal storytelling. Participants learn how to ideate with Firefly, draft scripts with AI, and batch content for YouTube, podcasts, and newsletters from a single prompt library.
